sloka: स समृद्धां मया सार्द्धमयोध्यां गच्छ राघव ।अभिषेचय चात्मानं कुलस्यास्य भवाय न: ॥ २.१०१.३॥
transliteration: sa samṛddhāṁ mayā sārddhamayodhyāṁ gaccha rāghava ।abhiṣecaya cātmānaṁ kulasyāsya bhavāya na: ॥ 2.101.3॥

translations.english: Therefore, O scion of the Raghu race, return along with me to prosperous Ayodhya and for the good of our race get your self coronated.
